headline.main: Benjamin Netanyahu Sought Deal With Hostile Newspaper, TV Report Says
headline.print_headline: Netanyahu Offered to Curb Competitor for Better Press in Paper, Report Says

multimedia.caption: The police are investigating Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s meeting with the publisher of a newspaper critical of him, a TV station reported.
